title: Prostate
summary: The prostate is a walnut-sized gland below the bladder that adds fluid to semen. It can be sensitive to stimulation and is sometimes called the 'P-spot'.
key_points: Prostate problems become more common with age; urinary changes are worth a doctor visit.
